name: Image Operations
description: Masks, resampling, crop, quarter turns and rotation by any angle with the straighten crop, blur, tone adjustments and histograms (levels, curves and histograms on linear or sRGB-encoded values) and cloning from an offset through a mask over PixelBuffer. W1/ declares the values the W1 engines share (AffineMatrix, ColorLUT, LayerEffect and the tone, matte, fill and gradient values), with no operations. Masks/ holds mask feathering, contours and mattes read from a buffer. Tone/ holds the color-family tone ops and the auto-tone suggestion. Effects/ holds the layer effects a PixelBuffer applies. Affine/ holds transforms through an AffineMatrix, flips and canvas padding. Fill/ holds flood fill by tolerance and raster gradient fills. Heal/ holds healing from sampled source pixels. Hash/ holds image hashes for comparing buffers.
